  genericrecords_nat_box echoed_box; genericrecords_nat_box_init(&echoed_box);
  CHECK(OK(genericrecords_echo_nat_box(&box, &echoed_box, &error)) && is_small(echoed_box.value, 4));
  genericrecords_nat_box_clear(&echoed_box);
  genericrecords_nat_box_again echo_again_in, echo_again_out;
  genericrecords_nat_box_again_init(&echo_again_in); genericrecords_nat_box_again_init(&echo_again_out);
  mpz_set_ui(echo_again_in.value, 4);
  CHECK(OK(genericrecords_echo_again(&echo_again_in, &echo_again_out, &error)) && is_small(echo_again_out.value, 4));
  genericrecords_nat_box_again_clear(&echo_again_in); genericrecords_nat_box_again_clear(&echo_again_out);
  genericrecords_text_box echo_text_in, echo_text_out;
  genericrecords_text_box_init(&echo_text_in); genericrecords_text_box_init(&echo_text_out);
  echo_text_in.value = text("text");
  CHECK(OK(genericrecords_echo_text_box(&echo_text_in, &echo_text_out, &error)) && same(&echo_text_out.value, "text"));
  mpz_clear(echo_text_in.count); genericrecords_text_box_clear(&echo_text_out);
  genericrecords_left_box left_in, left_out; genericrecords_left_box_init(&left_in); genericrecords_left_box_init(&left_out);
  mpz_set_ui(left_in.value, 5); mpz_set_ui(left_in.count, 2);
  CHECK(OK(genericrecords_echo_left(&left_in, &left_out, &error)) && is_small(left_out.value, 5));
  genericrecords_left_box_clear(&left_out);
  genericrecords_right_box right_in, right_out; genericrecords_right_box_init(&right_in); genericrecords_right_box_init(&right_out);
  mpz_set_ui(right_in.value, 6); mpz_set_ui(right_in.count, 3);
  CHECK(OK(genericrecords_echo_right(&right_in, &right_out, &error)) && is_small(right_out.count, 3));
  genericrecords_right_box_clear(&right_in); genericrecords_right_box_clear(&right_out);
  genericrecords_nat_box list_item; genericrecords_nat_box_init(&list_item); mpz_setbit(list_item.value, 70);
  genericrecords_list_lean_generic_records_nat_box_span echo_list = {&list_item, 1, NULL, NULL}, echo_list_out = {0};
  CHECK(OK(genericrecords_echo_boxes(&echo_list, &echo_list_out, &error)) && echo_list_out.length == 1 && mpz_cmp(echo_list_out.data[0].value, list_item.value) == 0);
  genericrecords_list_lean_generic_records_nat_box_span_clear(&echo_list_out);
  CHECK(OK(genericrecords_echo_boxes(&none, &echo_list_out, &error)) && echo_list_out.length == 0);
  genericrecords_list_lean_generic_records_nat_box_span_clear(&echo_list_out);
  genericrecords_option_list_lean_generic_records_nat_box_value echo_optional = {0}, echo_optional_out = {0};
  echo_optional.has_value = 1; echo_optional.value = echo_list;
  CHECK(OK(genericrecords_echo_optional_boxes(&echo_optional, &echo_optional_out, &error)) && echo_optional_out.has_value && echo_optional_out.value.length == 1 && mpz_cmp(echo_optional_out.value.data[0].value, list_item.value) == 0);
  genericrecords_option_list_lean_generic_records_nat_box_value_clear(&echo_optional_out);
  echo_optional.has_value = 0;
  CHECK(OK(genericrecords_echo_optional_boxes(&echo_optional, &echo_optional_out, &error)) && !echo_optional_out.has_value);
  genericrecords_option_list_lean_generic_records_nat_box_value_clear(&echo_optional_out);
  echo_optional.has_value = 1; echo_optional.value = none;
  CHECK(OK(genericrecords_echo_optional_boxes(&echo_optional, &echo_optional_out, &error)) && echo_optional_out.has_value && echo_optional_out.value.length == 0);
  genericrecords_option_list_lean_generic_records_nat_box_value_clear(&echo_optional_out);
  mpz_t echo_values[2]; mpz_init(echo_values[0]); mpz_init(echo_values[1]); mpz_setbit(echo_values[1], 70);
  genericrecords_list_nat_span echo_nats = {echo_values, 2, NULL, NULL}, echo_nats_out = {0}, echo_no_nats = {0};
  CHECK(OK(genericrecords_echo_nats(&echo_nats, &echo_nats_out, &error)) && echo_nats_out.length == 2 && mpz_cmp(echo_nats_out.data[1], echo_values[1]) == 0);
  genericrecords_list_nat_span_clear(&echo_nats_out);
  CHECK(OK(genericrecords_echo_nats(&echo_no_nats, &echo_nats_out, &error)) && echo_nats_out.length == 0);
  genericrecords_list_nat_span_clear(&echo_nats_out);
  genericrecords_option_nat_value echo_nat, echo_nat_out;
  genericrecords_option_nat_value_init(&echo_nat); genericrecords_option_nat_value_init(&echo_nat_out);
  echo_nat.has_value = 1; mpz_set(echo_nat.value, echo_values[1]);
  CHECK(OK(genericrecords_echo_optional_nat(&echo_nat, &echo_nat_out, &error)) && echo_nat_out.has_value && mpz_cmp(echo_nat_out.value, echo_values[1]) == 0);
  genericrecords_option_nat_value_clear(&echo_nat_out); genericrecords_option_nat_value_init(&echo_nat_out);
  echo_nat.has_value = 0;
  CHECK(OK(genericrecords_echo_optional_nat(&echo_nat, &echo_nat_out, &error)) && !echo_nat_out.has_value);
  genericrecords_option_nat_value_clear(&echo_nat_out); genericrecords_option_nat_value_clear(&echo_nat);
  mpz_set_si(left_in.value, -1); genericrecords_left_box_init(&left_out);
  CHECK(genericrecords_echo_left(&left_in, &left_out, &error) == GENERICRECORDS_STATUS_INVALID_ARGUMENT);
  mpz_set_ui(left_in.value, 7);
  CHECK(OK(genericrecords_echo_left(&left_in, &left_out, &error)) && is_small(left_out.value, 7));
  genericrecords_left_box_clear(&left_in); genericrecords_left_box_clear(&left_out);
  genericrecords_nat_box_clear(&list_item); mpz_clear(echo_values[0]); mpz_clear(echo_values[1]);
